programme.desc: International in-depth reports from the France 24 teams and our senior reporters around the world.

programme.title: Farm Forward Cooking
programme.desc: From a chef creating dishes that combine her Mexican and Indigenous heritage to a pizza pop up that improvs with farmers market ingredients to a backyard-run Indigenous dinner series, Stephanie Izard meets cooks taking their lead from the land.

programme.title: Family Style
programme.desc: From brothers selling mom’s Syrian food to a Filipino family remixing a classic dessert to a mom and son running an Indian restaurant out of their house, Stephanie meets multi-gen families turning family recipes into smash hit food business.

programme.title: Comfort Foods
programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Say Cheese
programme.desc: There’s no such thing as too much cheese, especially for these creators as they attempt record-setting cheese pulls and unique spins on the sensational feta pasta. Whose culinary creation will melt the internet?!

programme.title: Can You Hack It
programme.desc: Competitors push the creative limits of the well-known wrap hack, then aim to impress the judges by elevating another internet favorite in pasta pies. You may know these viral hacks well, but you’ve never seen them done quite like this.

programme.title: Holiday
programme.desc: The creators show off their best holiday handiwork in the kitchen, cranking out seasonal stuffed waffles and hot chocolate bomb-inspired desserts to celebrate the most wonderful time of the year.

programme.title: Snack Attack
programme.desc: The creators are challenged to shrink the internet’s favorite grubby meals down to miniature perfection and blow them up to gargantuan greatness. But size isn’t the only thing that matters to the judges, they’re looking for flawless flavor.

programme.title: Summer Fun
programme.desc: As summer heats up, the creators sweat it out in the kitchen putting an original spin on corn ribs and a transforming watermelon into a savory dish. Who will whip up this year’s hottest recipe?

programme.title: Dish in Disguise
programme.desc: The internet falls fast for snacks and hacks that look like one thing but taste like another. Creators must make "donuts" with anything but traditional batter, then flip the script on ramen, using it in an unconventional yet recognizable way.

programme.title: Make It or Bake It
programme.desc: Baking videos send our social media feeds in a frenzy and we can’t seem to get enough. Watch as creators impress the judges with a show stopping focaccia, then pay tribute to the mini pancake cereal trend by concocting their own unique cereal.

programme.title: Chicken or the Egg
programme.desc: No matter which came first, neither one is leaving the internet anytime soon. Creators aim to reinvent two iconic viral recipes, starting with a jazzed up egg sandwich sensation, and then their most innovative bucket of fried chicken.

programme.title: Extra-delicious
programme.desc: They say go big or don’t go at all. When it comes to some viral recipes, going all out is the method to internet madness. Creators customize a burrito made of homemade cotton candy, then shoot for the moon in an over the top nacho spread.

programme.title: Kids At Heart
programme.desc: There’s nothing more nostalgic than eating the good old meals from our childhood. Creators throw it back to some kid-friendly favorites, first with a personal rendition of the fried uncrustable, then with a three-course, microwave-only menu.

programme.desc: Latin-inspired ice cream to Caribbean, Channa curry doubles to gourmet, deli sandwiches; Stephanie Izard shows what comfort food means to 3 very different cooks and learns how they turned their childhood memories into thriving food businesses.

programme.title: Apocalypse Burgers

programme.title: Summer Surf 'n' Turf

programme.title: Luxe Lobster & Prime Rib

programme.desc: Frankie teaches us how to prepare tomatoes fresh in a variety of ways. And for even more savings, Frankie will share a few tips on how to preserve them so you can enjoy their freshness throughout the year.

programme.title: Holiday Flavors
programme.desc: The holiday season looks different this year, so why not mix things up and celebrate classic flavors in new and unexpected ways. Frankie teaches us to put a twist on all your holiday favorites, using simple ingredients for your loved ones to enjoy.

programme.title: Less Stress Holidays
programme.desc: The holidays are hectic enough, and with more planning, cooking and cleaning than usual, everyone wants to shop smart and save time. Frankie tackles weekday meals that will keep you organized, fed, and less stressed this season.

programme.title: The Count of Monte Cristo goes to Cuba
programme.desc: Chef Jason merges two iconic sandwiches into a super, savory powerhouse of flavors! Meet the Monte Cristo Cubano, complete with slow-roasted, mojo pork, country ham, and swiss cheese that is battered & deep-fried to perfection.

programme.title: Beef & Broccoli and Veggie Fried Rice: Chinese Takeout Staples
programme.desc: We’re having takeout tonight! Chef Shirley brings your favorite Chinese take-out classics straight to your kitchen! Just for you, she’s cooking up mouthwatering, Beef and Broccoli with Black Pepper Sauce, a fan favorite, and Veggie Fried Rice.

programme.title: Party for Pennies
programme.desc: Frankie makes three dishes for a party of four, that when combined, are cheaper than just one meal out for brunch. Then, it's a taco party for five people for only $20!

programme.title: Instant Gratification
programme.desc: Everyone loves carbs! Endlessly versatile, cheap, and super filling - Frankie shows you tricks for pasta, pizza dough, and delicious, easy ramen meals that aren't soup.

programme.title: All About the Apps
programme.desc: Who needs a main meal when you can fill up on appetizers? From cauliflower fritters, to chicken wings, to tiny taquitos we're starting this party off right!

programme.title: Grilled to Great
programme.desc: Fire up the grill because we've got some great grub for you! We're making grilled pork belly, spicy chicken tacos, and gooey grilled cheese kabobs.

programme.title: Whitney Cummings & Miranda Cosgrove make Tiny Spaghetti & Meatballs
programme.desc: Whitney Cummings & Miranda Cosgrove go head-to-head as they attempt to recreate our Tiny Spaghetti & Meatballs. We dive into their love for animals, the history of their friendship, and even talk tasty treats...but only one will win the tiny trophy!

programme.title: Jennifer Tilly & Devon Sawa make Tiny Pumpkin Pie
programme.desc: Jennifer Tilly & Devon Sawa bring in the fall festivities as well as the Halloween horror as they recreate our Tiny Pumpkin Pie. They discuss scream queens, and love scenes, and get very competitive when it comes to perfect pie - winner takes fall!

programme.title: Tori Spelling & Teddi Mellencamp make Tiny French Toast with Homemade Strawberry Syrup
programme.desc: Don’t miss the Beverly Hills ladies who brunch as Tori Spelling & Teddi Mellencamp make Tiny French Toast with Homemade Strawberry Syrup. They spill the tea on having famous fathers and candy cravings...but who’s toast will be trophy-worthy?

programme.title: Ryan Hansen & Jimmy O. Yang make Tiny Cake Pops
programme.desc: Monica’s bestie Ryan Hansen & his bud Jimmy O. Yang take their friendship to the next level by making Tiny Cake Pops. Jimmy gives us the scoop on how he spent his early paychecks and Ryan talks dancing and Dax...but only 1 will take the tiny cake!

programme.title: Lucy Lawless & Renee O'Connor Make Tiny Chili Cheese Nachos
programme.desc: It’s a battle for the ages as Lucy Lawless & Renee O’Connor reunite from their warrior princess days to recreate Tiny Chili Cheese Nachos. They talk stunts & metal bras and some smoke ensues - but only one will burn the competition to the ground.

programme.title: Paul Scheer & Rob Huebel Make Tiny Carrot Cake
programme.desc: Rob Huebel & Paul Scheer put their cooking chops to the test as they attempt to recreate our Tiny Carrot Cake. Rob fancies himself a silver fox and Paul talks about his Trekkie days, but only one will take the tiny trophy in this comedic food fight.

programme.title: Jerkin' and GRILLIN'
programme.desc: Back from a trip to Negril, Jamaica, chef Derrell Smith brings his favorite dishes back to his own yard! Grillin’ up Jerk Chicken, Saltfish and Ackee, coconut peas and rice and other Caribbean favorites for his two friends.

programme.title: Farmer's Market Finds
programme.desc: Chef Derrell Smith heads to the Farmers Market for the first time. Inspired by rows of fresh fruit, veggies and the local farmers he creates a flavorful meal like Veggie Focaccia, Mushroom Medley Pasta, Spiced Apple Cobbler and a crisp white Sangria.

programme.title: Summer BBQ
programme.desc: Summer is coming to a close but there’s still a bounty of fresh, seasonal produce to enjoy. Celebrate with Frankie as he makes some of his favorite cookout classics that’ll take you from a weekend picnic to a backyard BBQ, with or without a grill.

programme.title: Super Squash
programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of squash: they’re affordable, abundant and they come in all shapes, sizes, colors, and textures. Frankie spotlights squash from summer through winter highlighting their amazing superhero traits.

programme.desc: Iman dipaksa berkahwin dengan Qaseh, anak kepada orang gajinya untuk mewarisi harta bapanya. Percutian mereka di Bosnia membuahkan bibit-bibit cinta. Lakonan Iqram Dinzly, Zarina Zainoordin dan Yana Shamsudin.

programme.title: Kampung Kuala Lambat

programme.title: Musnahkan Pelamin Anganku
programme.desc: Mikael yang merupakan seorang wedding planner menerima tawaran besar untuk menjayakan sebuah majlis perkahwinan pelanggannya. Namun majlis perkahwinan tersebut merupakan majlis bekas isterinya.

programme.title: Dua
programme.desc: Kisah Farhan yang kehilangan kembarnya Fahrin dalam satu kemalangan tragis. Dia kemudiannya mengambil-alih kehidupan Fahrin namun terperangkap dalam sebuah cinta tiga segi pula. Lakonan Eusoff Hashim dan Sharifah Sakinah.

programme.title: Racun Menantu
programme.desc: After marrying Zain, Sara lived in the same house with Pak Dolah, her father-in-law. Because of the family's grudge, Sara started making trouble by seducing her own father-in-law.

programme.title: Cupid
programme.desc: Kisah mengenai seorang ejen yang bekerja di sebuah syarikat penghancur jodoh yang ditugaskan untuk memikat seorang wanita supaya dapat melupakan suaminya yang telah diisytiharkan meninggal dunia. Namun dia jatuh cinta pada wanita tersebut

programme.title: Cerai
programme.desc: Pengalaman berkurung dengan pasangan selama musim PKP memaksa dua pasangan suami isteri menilai semula perkahwinan mereka yang telah disalah ertikan selama ini.

programme.title: Hingga Jumpa Lagi
programme.desc: Eva is diagnosed with cancer and prays that she could travel back to the past in order to prevent the love between her and her husband so that her husband can lead a happy life. Her prayer is granted…

programme.title: I Heart You Cik Yah
programme.desc: Zulkefli and Badariah are always arguing, but in order to prevent the factory where they work from being closed by Qarina, they must work together. Out of hatred, they start feeling for each other.

programme.title: Jihan Nak Displin Anak
programme.desc: Jihan dan suami kalut apabila anak mereka tidak mahu pulang beraya di kampung. Mereka cuba untuk mendisiplinkan anak mereka sebelum hari raya

programme.title: Satu Kampung Dua Orang
programme.desc: Selepas banjir besar melanda, semua penduduk kampung berpindah kerana kampung mereka tidak lagi selamat. Hanya dua beradik yang enggan berpindah atas sebab dan alasan mereka tersendiri.

programme.title: Jamil Balik Kampung
programme.desc: Kisah perjalanan Jamil pulang ke kampung untuk meminang kekasihnya setelah pinangannya pernah ditolak beberapa kali. Berjayakah misi Jamil kali ini?

programme.title: Sampai Nanti
programme.desc: Kyle dan Milly bertemu kembali setelah 10 tahun terpisah dan cinta lama kembali terjalin. Tetapi adakah cinta mereka akan terus kekal hingga ke akhirnya?

programme.title: Asam Pedas Cendol Sejoli
programme.desc: Karim adalah pemilik kedai cendol bersebelahan dengan kedai asam pedas Kalsom. Mereka bermusuhan, tetapi anak mereka – Kinah dan Khalil – mencintai satu sama lain, dan terpaksa menyembunyikan perkara ini bagi mengelakkan perang antara dua kedai mereka.

programme.title: Tolong Saya Encik Dinosaur
programme.desc: Elly berpindah dari bandar ke pekan kecil untuk mencari ketenangan. Tetapi kenangan buruk tetap menghantui dirinya, sehinggalah dia bertemu dengan Karl yang mengajarnya erti sebuah kebahagiaan.

programme.title: Cubit - Cubit Cinta

programme.title: Duit Kawin

programme.title: Biarkan Cinta Tersenyum Lagi

programme.title: Ayat Dari Langit
programme.desc: Ustaz Muiz dan isterinya mengajar ajaran sesat dan mahu pengikutnya mengikut telunjuk mereka yang lama kelamaan mula membuatkan pengikutnya bernama Kamal mula merasa sangsi.

programme.title: Cinta Round 1
programme.desc: Farid is a nerdy guy who always been bullied by Syakirin, his senior. Farid determined to enter an MMA tournament organized by their university so to put an end to being bullied by Syakirin.

programme.title: Racun Suami Jahanam

programme.title: 6 Hari
programme.desc: Suzi is content with being a third wife and living alone in her bungalow as she only entertains her husband every 6 days. Everything comes crashing when a person from her past returns to her life.

programme.title: Please Subscribe Cintaku

programme.title: Diva Dari Jakarta
programme.desc: Erin dan Ejot sering dibandingkan dari segi paras rupa. Sehingga suatu hari sesuatu telah berlaku kepada Erin yang mengubah segalanya.

programme.desc: Hari terbahagia dalam hidup Nora berubah menjadi suram bila tunangnya menarik diri pada hari pernikahan mereka. Tambah buruk lagi, hari selepas tragedi itu asyik berulang atas sebab-sebab misteri.

programme.title: Best Of Pets
programme.desc: Another episode of Best of Pets with funny pet clips.

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them. For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc. Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from "The Avengers"!

programme.desc: Brother Hui, who runs an amphibian and reptile store in Xinxing District, Kaohsiung City, has a wide range of knowledge in the field of reptiles. He started with red-eared sliders and gradually got in touch with tortoises, lizards, snakes and other reptile pets. In Brother Hui's brick-and-mortar store, the most special existence is the two store pets, the South American lizards. The male is called Meatball and the female is called Porkball. How did their fate with Brother Hui begin? Brother Hui, who has many years of experience in raising South American lizards, also generously share his breeding secrets. How to distinguish male and female South American lizards? How to keep them healthy? What's the secret to taming them? In this epsiode, we unpack the living environment of South American lizards and reveal the breeding guide!

programme.desc: Dr. Matt has a heavyweight problem to tackle -V Kifarou, one of Flamingoland's male white rhinos, has a skin infection. At Matt's surgery, he operates on a kestrel with a broken wing. When wildlife rescuer Jean Thorpe arrives to collect the patient, Matt has another bundle for her, a poorly duck with suspected lead poisoning.

programme.title: The Dog Rescuers
programme.desc: In Greater Manchester shockingly injured Saluki Susie limps onto a petrol station forecourt and into Inspector Becky Goulding's life. Susie's found with football socks tied tightly around her legs. One fractured leg is damaged beyond repair and has to be removed. After Susie's sad start will she find her happy ending?

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: Genus Pterophyllum, commonly known as P. scalare, freshwater angelfish or just angelfish is a large tropical fish native to the Amazon River in South America.They have a laterally flattened body, making them suitableto live in the crevices of tree roots in rivers with smooth water flow, and feeds on aquatic insects. The water temperature should be maintained at 26℃, and should reach 27-28℃ when breeding. The fertilized eggs are then released and attached to water plants or rocks, and the couple will take care of them together. However, once the eggs are hatched, the bigger ones will eat the smaller ones, hence not suitable to be raised together with other small fishes.

programme.title: Vacation Deluxe
programme.desc: In the middle of the Allgäu at the foot of the Alps, a holiday park of superlatives is being built on a gigantic area of 184 hectares! The construction of the new holiday park will cost a total of 350 million euros. Around 5000 guests are to spend their holidays in 1000 holiday homes. But it is still a long way to the opening: it is the largest building site southern Germany has ever seen. On this area, which is as big as 258 football fields, about one million holiday guests per year are expected soon. Around 1100 men are working at full capacity to ensure that everything is ready in time for the park's opening. 1000 holiday homes must be ready and habitable by then. A spa, an adventure pool, indoor playgrounds and 6 restaurants are also planned. The workers are under enormous time pressure. Will the mega holiday park be ready in time before the first guests arrive?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E04 - Driving the Bus
programme.desc: Chris y Casey se inician en los sabores de la naturaleza neozelandesa y sufren un duro despertar. Los juegos mentales de la Madre Naturaleza empiezan a afectar a la fuerza mental de los hermanos, mientras su balsa hinchable sigue siendo un grave problema.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E05 - Round Two
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Chris and Casey disagree on what their next course of action should be. Without clear cache directions, the brothers are left with a hard choice. Should they stay, or should they go?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E06 - Peaks and Valleys
programme.desc: Chris y Casey caminan por la ladera de la montaña, pero las empinadas laderas y el esquisto movedizo hacen que la caminata no sea nada fácil. Los hermanos se enfrentan al agotamiento y la falta de energía, y sienten la presión de encontrar pronto nuevas fuentes de alimento o pasar hambre.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E07 - Day in the Life
programme.desc: La balsa sigue causando problemas mientras Chris y Casey gastan valiosas energías intentando mantenerse a flote. Con sus días en el Pacífico Sur menguando, los hermanos han llegado a su punto de ruptura'hasta que un nuevo descubrimiento deja un impacto duradero.

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E08 - Bridge the Gap
programme.desc: Chris y Casey han atravesado Nueva Zelanda a pie durante semanas. Luchar por sus vidas ha hecho mella en sus emociones y habilidades. Se asocian para cazar jabalíes, pero los alijos utilizados para sobrevivir crean nuevos retos y profundas frustraciones.

programme.title: The Trail- S01:E03 - Relocation
programme.desc: Laramy se da cuenta de que la caza escasea debido a los lobos y decide poner distancia entre él y la manada. Es hora de levantar el campamento y trasladarse a un nuevo lugar.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E04 - White Death
programme.desc: La nieve, lo que los montañeses llamaban la muerte blanca, detiene a Laramy en su camino. Además, su fiel caballo 7 ha sufrido una herida en una pata. Laramy debe cuidar de Siete, luchar contra el hambre y sobrevivir a la nevada.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E05 - The Struggle
programme.desc: Laramy sigue atrapado en el Campamento Hell Hole, cuidando de la pierna de 7, y luchando por sobrevivir a las gélidas temperaturas sin comida.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E06 - On the Move
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete abandonan el campamento Hell Hole y emprenden de nuevo el camino. Se dirigen a una elevación más baja en busca de un lugar más permanente al que llamar hogar.

programme.title: The Trail - S01:E07 - Permanent Residence
programme.desc: Laramy y Siete encuentran un lugar para acampar a largo plazo fuera de la nieve y a menor altitud. Laramy se pone manos a la obra para construir un refugio permanente y buscar comida.

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S01:E10 - Season Recap

programme.title: Fight to Survive - S02:E01 - After the Fall

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E02 - Terry Loves 70's Cop Shows
programme.desc: 特里回到70年代，在那裡他可以重溫童年的夢想，成為70年代的電視警察。拉里幫助特里測試幾個場景，包括躲在車門後以尋找掩護，以及是否真的可以從汽車上射擊油箱使其爆炸。

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E07 - Danger Asteroids Ahead
programme.desc: A menudo se plantea la cuestión de si el coste de la exploración espacial merece realmente la pena. ¿Podría invertirse mejor el dinero en otra cosa? De ser así, un programa espacial tendría que seguir existiendo. El programa de defensa planetaria, para localizar, identificar y desviar un asteroide caprichoso que impacte contra la Tierra y destruya nuestra civilización, ya que, según el último recuento, había 15.000 posibles candidatos peligrosos cerca de la Tierra.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E08 - First Light
programme.desc: Para ser un instrumento desarrollado en el siglo XVII, el telescopio ha recorrido un largo camino. La última versión del otrora humilde telescopio llegará mucho más lejos, acercándonos cada vez más a la primera luz que bañó el Universo en el que vivimos.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E42 - Diana A Model Princess

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: 當戴安娜訂婚時，她始終處於媒體的視野中。她在一生中專注於自己的兒子，並致力於慈善工作，例如對地雷發表意見。戴安娜利用自己的名氣來引起人們對這些和其他重要問題的關注。這部經過深思熟慮的節目更深入地研究了20世紀最驚人的人物之一。通過前所未見的畫面，它展示了她從一個害羞的少女走到成為威爾士公主戴安娜的歷程，包括她最後日子的感人時刻。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E01 - Antler Raiders
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲守衛試圖控制人群，當大門打開時，角獅獵人被釋放以尋找他們的獎杯。

programme.title: Wardens - S04:E02 - Across The Seeded Fields
programme.desc: 蒙大拿的遊戲護理員在第一天的雞頭鷂季節出動，密切監視合規與不合規的狩獵行為，確保播種田地不受損害。

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E05 - Round Two
programme.desc: Tensions run high as Chris and Casey disagree on what their next course of action should be. Without clear cache directions, the brothers are left with a hard choice. Should they stay, or should they go?

programme.title: Dropped - S06:E06 - Peaks and Valleys
programme.desc: Chris y Casey caminan por la ladera de la montaña, pero las empinadas laderas y el esquisto movedizo hacen que la caminata no sea nada fácil. programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S03:E03 - Breaking Terry Badly
